models.title: Idol Turns Single Images into 3D Gaussian Splats Efficiently
models.summary: Idol converts a single picture, render, or generated image into up to 1,048,576 3D Gaussians written as a standard 3DGS .ply file. It runs on consumer GPUs, uses 7.2 GB of VRAM, and executes in under 2 seconds.
models.why: It offers rapid single-image 3D asset generation directly on consumer hardware.

models.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro Launched as Open-Weight Multimodal Agentic Model
models.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight, natively multimodal agentic 2.8T-class MoE model with 104B activated parameters and a 1-million-token context window, delivering major improvements in coding, 3D creation, and financial research.
models.why: It introduces a massive open-weight multimodal architecture with strong agentic and 3D capabilities.

models.title: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder Explores Small Models for 3D Scene Generation
models.summary: CCORE released an early preview of Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder, an independent fine-tune focused on general-purpose coding and generating interactive 3D scenes using Three.js.
models.why: Explores the feasibility of lightweight models for specialized 3D graphical coding tasks.

models.title: Ripple-65B Preview Dense Transformer Released with 1M Token Context
models.summary: Ricursive Intelligence introduced Ripple-65B Preview, a 65B dense Transformer pretrained on 12 trillion tokens supporting up to 1 million context tokens. It scores 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1, outperforming several larger open-weight models.
models.why: Demonstrates high-performance agentic coding capabilities in a dense 65B architecture.

models.title: Qwen3.8-27B Model Weights and Configuration Files Published
models.summary: The repository provides model weights and configuration files for the post-trained Qwen3.8-27B model, compatible with Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, and TokenSpeed.
models.why: Provides direct access to a mid-sized Qwen base model for local inference and integration.

models.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED Released as Compact Reasoning Model
models.summary: A decensored and reasoning-focused fine-tune of Qwen3.5-9B, this 9B parameter model is distilled from DeepSeek-V4-Pro in Max Effect mode, concentrating its supervised training signal on mathematics and STEM problem solving.
models.why: Provides an open, distilled reasoning model tailored for math and technical tasks.
